## Immediate kinds

| Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|
| s16 | signed, −32768…32767, sign-extended |
| u16 | unsigned, 0…65535, zero-extended |
| sh | shift width 0…31 |
| sys | system call number 0…65535 |
| mem | memory operand: base register + signed offset −32768…32767, or absolute 0…0xFFFF (B = 15) |
| rel20 | signed 20-bit offset in words, relative to this instruction |

## Flag effects

| Effect | Z, N | C | V |
|---|---|---|---|
| – | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |
| add | from result | carry out of bit 31 | signed overflow |
| sub | from result | borrow: a < b unsigned (x86 convention) | signed overflow |
| mul | from result | product does not fit in u32 | product does not fit in i32 |
| div | from result | 0 | 1 exactly for INT_MIN / −1 |
| logic | from result | 0 | 0 |
| shift | from result | last bit shifted out (0 for width 0) | 0 |
